title.en: Gold v2 dependency and SmartPay5 metadata correction
title.zh: Gold v2 依赖与 SmartPay5 元数据修正

purpose.en: Keep the patched dependency release and correct SmartLingo's public SmartPay5 integration metadata to match its actual course products and ownership model.
purpose.zh: 保留依赖安全修复，并使 SmartLingo 的公开 SmartPay5 集成元数据与实际课程产品及所有权模型一致。

en: Publish the three SmartLingo three-month course MainIDs, selected language SecondID semantics, signed-in PayerID, and permanent-administrator RefID semantics.
zh: 发布三个 SmartLingo 三个月课程 MainID、所选语言 SecondID、登录用户 PayerID 及永久管理员 RefID 的正确语义。

en: Dependency resolution, public SmartPay5 ABI metadata, its regression contract, and the exact release record.
zh: 影响依赖解析、公开 SmartPay5 ABI 元数据、对应回归合同及精确发布记录。

en: Remove stale BingAcademy identifiers and the obsolete member-profile RefID description from the SmartLingo ABI endpoint.
Add a regression check that fails if cross-site identifiers or incorrect identity semantics return.
zh: 从 SmartLingo ABI 接口移除残留的 BingAcademy 标识及过时的会员资料 RefID 描述。
增加回归检查，防止跨站标识或错误身份语义再次出现。

en: Require zero npm audit vulnerabilities, 74-migration replay, all source contracts, exact WebKit matrix gate, exact deployment, production API probes, and matching private Project evidence; no manual realtime browser testing.
Verify uppercase and lowercase PayerID queries resolve the same SmartPay5 transaction index.
zh: 要求 npm 审计零漏洞、74 个迁移重放、全部源码合同、精确 WebKit 矩阵门禁、精确部署、生产 API 探测及匹配的私有 Project 证据；不做手动实时浏览器测试。
验证大写与小写 PayerID 查询解析到同一个 SmartPay5 交易索引。

en: No contract bytecode, payment rules, database schema, product price, provider setting, entitlement, or production data changes.
zh: 不修改合约字节码、付款规则、数据库架构、产品价格、服务商设置、权益或生产数据。

en: Preserve SmartLingo branding, language-learning products, Clerk, RealtimeKit, SmartPay5 runtime, referral, certificate, header, footer, and independent infrastructure boundaries.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 品牌、语言学习产品、Clerk、RealtimeKit、SmartPay5 运行逻辑、推荐、证书、页眉页脚及独立基础设施边界。

rollback.en: No data migration is included; roll back only this metadata release if required.
rollback.zh: 不包含数据迁移；如有需要，仅回滚本次元数据发布。
